source.label: Bob's Guide to Classic Pinball Machines

supportingSources.label: Aleksander Kaczmarczyk at Pittsburgh Pinball Open 2019 Classics III — Finals

strategy.summary: Plunge lane 2 to light the spinner and open the right gate. Repeat the spinner for 1,000 per spin. Let the bumpers feed the saucer for 5x, then protect the 145,000 bonus.

steps.text: Plunge the center lane 2. The top lanes read 1-4-2-5-3 from left to right.
modeNotes: Lane 2: Lights the spinner and opens the right-outlane gate. It is the only number that has no duplicate playfield target.
Right gate: A right-outlane ball returns to the shooter lane. Using the gate turns off both the gate and spinner.

steps.text: From the left flipper, shoot the spinner with full power. Repeat it for 1,000 per spin while lit.
modeNotes: Spinner: Scores 100 per spin when unlit and 1,000 when lit.
Shoot it even when unlit. A completed shot returns the ball to the top for another chance at lane 2.

steps.text: When the ball reaches the right flipper, tap pass to the left. Do not replace the spinner route with low-value standups.
Let bumper action feed the upper-right saucer. If its kickout is controlled, live catch and repeat it until Bonus X reaches 5x.
modeNotes: Bonus X saucer: Each collect advances 2x, 3x, then 5x. There is no 4x step.
Do not force the saucer when the spinner is strong. Incidental saucer entries are enough for the main plan.

steps.text: Repeat the spinner and upper-playfield trips until base bonus reaches 29,000. Protect the 5x collect at the drain.
If the right gate saves a ball, plunge lane 2 again. This relights the gate and spinner before you resume the loop.

fallback.title: Spinner without 5x
fallback.when: Use this when the saucer kickout is dangerous or the upper saucer does not collect cleanly.

steps.text: Ignore the saucer. Keep the ball on the left flipper.
Repeat the lit spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Use each top return to relight lane 2 and advance bonus.
Accept the lower Bonus X rather than risking the saucer.

alternatives.title: Number-set awards
alternatives.when: Use this only when lane 2 is already collected and another number is safely available.

steps.text: The first set lights center stars for bonus; the second lights the left Jet Stream for bonus.
The third set lights 3,000 top lanes and a 3,000 drop-bank completion.
The fourth set lights 1,000 rollovers and an extra ball or its tournament conversion.
Keep lane 2, the right gate, and the spinner lit.
Reach 5x through repeated upper-right saucer entries.
Repeat the spinner and upper-playfield trips until base bonus reaches 29,000. Drain without tilting.

techniques.name: Tap pass
techniques.instruction: Tap the right flipper as the ball settles. Move it to the left flipper for the spinner shot.

techniques.name: Live catch
techniques.instruction: When the kickout reaches a flipper cleanly, drop that flipper on contact. Cradle and repeat the saucer for the next Bonus X step.

techniques.name: Dead bounce
techniques.instruction: If the left-chute feed lands on the right flipper consistently, let it bounce to the left flipper. Then resume the spinner loop.

cautions.issue: The saucer kickout can return too fast or toward the center.
cautions.response: Test the first eject. Use a live catch only when the feed reaches the flipper cleanly; otherwise, stay on spinner.

cautions.issue: The left Jet Stream chute can feed an outlane, sling, or center drain.
cautions.response: Watch the first chute exit. Shoot it only when its feed gives a safe dead bounce or cradle.

cautions.issue: A spinner shot that does not clear the lane can fall back toward a drain.
cautions.response: Use full power and find the clean angle. Stop repeated spinner shots when rejections do not reach a flipper.

quickInfo.summary: Plunge lane 2 to light the spinner and open the right gate.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Keep lane 2, the right gate, and the spinner lit.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Supersonic, plunge top lane 2 to light the spinner and open the right-outlane gate. Repeat the spinner from the left flipper for 1,000 per spin, and use each return to collect lane 2 again. Let the upper-right saucer collect naturally until Bonus X reaches 5x.
strategy.overview: In Supersonic, top lane 2 lights the spinner and opens the right-outlane gate, while the upper-right saucer raises Bonus X through 2x, 3x, and 5x. Repeat the lit spinner for 1,000 per spin and use its top return to relight lane 2. Take natural saucer entries, build 29,000 base bonus, and protect the 145,000 end-of-ball collect.
